The *Kassapabuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 26) constitutes the twenty-sixth chapter of the canonical *Buddhavaṁsa*, situated within the late strata of the Pali Sutta Piṭaka. Bearing the title translated as *The History of the Buddha Kassapa*, the text delivers the biographical verse chronicle of Kassapa, the twenty-fourth past Buddha of the lineage and the immediate predecessor to Gotama Buddha.
